name: App v0.8.0
body:
### Added

- Android support. The app now runs on Android devices. This required a substantial UI refactor, so the app's appearance may change in this release.
- Internationalization (i18n) support. Spanish and English are supported.
- Home link in the window bar for quickly returning to the home view.
- Logs page to inspect application logs. This page helps diagnose problems in production.
- Improved Google Reader–compatible sync support; entries are now synced as well.

### Changed

- Mark entries as read on scroll instead of on hover (behavior change; may be a breaking UX change). Hover behavior does not work well on mobile, and marking on scroll is a more common pattern.

### Fixed

- Removed the account sync button from the accounts menu; Google Reader–style accounts now sync when entries are loaded.
- Scraping is now optional and must be triggered manually to be more respectful of publishers' pages.
- Removed duplicated titles from entry content.
- New accounts are set as the current account when created.
- "Read later" entries are always shown even if they were already marked as read.
- Links inside article views open in the external browser by default.
- Cache entries to preserve index/scroll position when returning to a list.
- Ensure the current account is correctly checked when loading local config and database data.
- Implement edit and sync for Google Reader–style accounts.

### CI

- Added Android build to CI pipelines.


See the assets to download this version and install.

name: App v0.3.0
body:
🔧 **New Features & Improvements** 🔧

- **Support for Multiple Accounts**: You can now add both local accounts and Google Reader API-compliant accounts, making it easier to manage your subscriptions across different services.
  
- **API Sync with Google Reader API**: Integrated sync functionality with services like **FreshRSS**, **Miniflux**, and **TinyTiny RSS** for seamless feed management. **Work in progress**, currently just sync subscriptions and folders.

- **Onboarding**: A new onboarding experience to guide users through setting up and using the app more easily.

- **Multiple Light and Dark Themes**: Added more theme options, so you can switch between light and dark modes to match your preferences.

- **Enhanced Code Structure**: We've improved the overall structure of the codebase, making it cleaner and more maintainable.

- **Improved Feed Adding Flow**: Adjusted the process for adding a new feed, especially with multiple accounts support, making it smoother.

- **Sidebar Refactor**: The sidebar has been refactored for better usability and organization.

🔧 **Small Fixes & Enhancements** 🔧

- Various UI tweaks and minor bug fixes to enhance performance and stability.

See the assets to download this version and install.

name: Chaski v0.1.0
body:
# Chaski - First Release 🚀

This is the initial release of Chaski. Please note that it **may not be fully tested** and **could have bugs or unexpected behavior**. However, I hope it will still be useful to some of you.

## Core Features:
- Manage and organize feeds
- Read feed entries
- Dark/Light mode
- Export/Import OPML
- Autodiscovery of feeds
- And more...

Feel free to try it out, provide feedback, and report any issues you encounter!


See the assets to download this version and install.
